messages:
maria: dropped a compact mock for the trace drilldown header and clipboard behavior. two quick decisions: (1) where to surface a lightweight download action (header icon vs footer persistent action) and (2) exact copy & announce behavior for copying the truncated correlation id. figma: https://figma.com/s/trace-drilldown-clipboard

*tariq:* i'd keep a small download icon in the header for fast incident workflows, but not as a primary button. make it icon-only with an explicit accessible label. also, keep a larger 'Download stack as text' in the footer for full exports.

*sam:* agree. accessibility note: if the icon is visible, ensure tab order doesn't break the common flow of copying CID first. prefer order: CID -> more -> download. otherwise keyboard users keep tabbing past the id.

*katie:* copy suggestions:
- header icon aria-label: "Download trace bundle"
- footer button text: "Download stack as text"
- under truncated CID: microcopy "Click to copy full correlation ID"
Also propose tooltip on hover showing full CID so folks can verify before copying.

*olivia:* a11y behavior: when user activates the CID copy, announce via `aria-live` region: "Full correlation ID copied" and include a short SR-friendly description like "Correlation ID copied to clipboard". avoid announcing full ID out loud.

*maria:* good point on not speaking the ID. i also want visual feedback: a short toast "Copied" with a link-to-view action. but SR should get the more detailed confirmation without reading the actual ID string.

*tariq:* implementation nit: use a visually-hidden element with id `cid-copy-status` and set it as the `aria-live='polite'` container. on copy, update the text to "Correlation ID copied to clipboard". ensure we don't put the full ID into that node.

*sam:* focus handling: after copying, keep focus on the CID element so keyboard users can continue workflow. avoid moving focus to the toast. toasts should be dismissible and not steal focus.

*katie:* microcopy variations for CID helper:
- "Click to copy full correlation ID"
- "Copy full correlation ID"
- "Click to copy full ID"
I prefer the first for clarity.

*maria:* decision proposal:
- header: show tiny download icon (icon-only) to left of kebab; keep export in kebab too
- footer: persistent text export button: 'Download stack as text'
- CID helper: 'Click to copy full correlation ID' + tooltip preview on hover
- copy action: update `aria-live` polite container with 'Correlation ID copied to clipboard' (no raw ID)
- keep focus on CID after copy; toast appears but does not grab focus
- tab order: CID -> more -> download

*tariq:* acceptance criteria:
- keyboard: CID accessible and copyable via Enter/Space; tab order enforced
- SR: `aria-live` reads confirmation, but not raw ID; header icon label reads correctly
- visual: icon has visible focus ring and tooltip accessible by keyboard
- contrast: helper text meets 4.5:1

*olivia:* extra a11y nit: ensure tooltip is reachable via focus (i.e., when CID is focused, pressing ? or a dedicated reveal key shows full CID tooltip), or include a small focusable button to expand preview if hover-only tooltips can't be reliably keyboard-accessed.

*maria:* good call. i'll add a tiny focusable 'show' affordance next to the CID that reveals the full ID in a dialog-like region. that control will announce "Full correlation ID preview" and be reachable by tab.

*sam:* if we add a preview control, keep it out of the main tab flow by making it optional behind an expandable chevron for compact mode. acceptance: preview control reachable and SR announces preview opened.

*katie:* i'll run VoiceOver on mac once the prototype is up and verify the `aria-live` and tooltip behavior.

*tariq:* i'll draft the exact attributes: `button` for download icon with `aria-label="Download trace bundle"`, `aria-describedby` for helper text, `role="status"` or `aria-live="polite"` for the hidden copy status node, and ensure `prefers-reduced-motion` respected for any animations.

*design-bot:* checklist: keyboard order, aria-labels present, `aria-live` for copy confirmation, focus management after copy, tooltip reachable via keyboard, contrast check, reduced-motion respected. Missing: documented SR message for download start.

*maria:* i'll update figma and prototype keyboard tab stops + the hidden `aria-live` message. can someone volunteer to run a SR pass after i push?

*katie:* i'll do VoiceOver and post notes.

*sam:* i'll run NVDA and test keyboard flow and the preview control.

*olivia:* i'll validate the `aria-live` behavior with a screen reader on linux.

*maria:* thanks team. leaving this open until prototype. react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the plan.

*katie:* :thumbsup:

*sam:* :thumbsup:

*tariq:* :thumbsup:

*olivia:* :thumbsup:

*design-bot:* thread archived in 7 days if inactive."
